title: Receipt Line with Interpolation
hints: Keep money in integer cents; `/ 100` gives dollars and `% 100` gives cents.
Write a small helper that formats cents as `$D.CC`, padding the cents to two digits.
Pad with `\(remainder < 10 ? "0" : "")\(remainder)`, then interpolate everything: `"\(quantity) x \(item) @ \(dollars(unitCents)) = \(dollars(quantity * unitCents))"`.
